Micromégas Project

Welcome to the Micromégas Project page. This site documents the planning and design of the Letterblaster Press edition of Micromégas by Voltaire.

Title Micromegas
Author Voltaire
Translator Peter Phalen
URL https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/30123
Translation of https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/4649

Letterblaster Press aims to provide ready-to-print PDFs of public domain texts that are thoughtfully designed with a keen eye for typographic details. Letterblaster PDFs are designed for print with the hand bookbinder in mind. If you’re looking to read this work online or on an e-reader, check out the Project Gutenberg links above for more suitable file formats.
